name: Retool AI
tagline: Retool is a low-code platform for building internal business tools, dashboards, and admin panels. Its AI features let developers query databases, call APIs, and chain AI models using natural language. Retool AI agents can take actions inside the app — submitting forms, running queries, or triggering workflows — based on user requests.
